runtime_target.rule: Accept only when both target text and /200 are confirmed in the same mission detail state. Otherwise refresh. Recognition failure is not the same as a confirmed non-target result.

templates.role: detect and select an unselected mission slot
positive target condition: target text plus 0/200
accept only a positively confirmed target mission
sample progress layout; the numerator must be parsed dynamically

click_rule: Locate the allowed template in the current ADB screenshot, compute the matched rectangle center, and tap that center on the same ADB serial. Never use source-video coordinates as fixed runtime tap coordinates.
non_target_rule: Do not maintain templates or a name list for non-target missions. If the positive target pair is confidently absent from a valid new-mission detail screen, refresh again.
